timeline.label: Skewer
timeline.evidence: Re1+ skewers the king on g1 and the rook on h1. No legal reply saves the rear target without conceding material.

timeline.label: Skewer Payoff
timeline.evidence: Rxh1 collects the rook on h1, the material payoff of the earlier skewer (Re1+).

motifs.label: Forcing Mate
motifs.evidence: Rxe1+ starts a forced mating attack. Every legal defence permits mate within 2 moves; one verified line is Rxe1+ Rxe1 Qxg2#. The exact continuation depends on the defence.

motifs.label: Checkmate
motifs.evidence: Qxg2# is checkmate: the king is in check and there is no legal reply.
